name: Trinity Church
heritage: National Historic Landmark; National Register of Historic Places listed place
text: Trinity Church in the City of Boston, located in the Back Bay neighborhood of Boston, Massachusetts, is a parish of the Episcopal Diocese of Massachusetts. The congregation, currently standing at approximately 4,000 households, was founded in 1733. Three services are offered each Sunday, and weekday services are offered four times a week from September through June.

depictions.text: Trinity Church (Manhattan) Trinity Church is an Episcopalian church located in Lower Manhattan in New York, at the intersection of Wall Street and Broadway.
